# Alta General Contracting Ltd.

> Edmonton general contractor established in 1999. Your one stop shop for all your contracting needs.

Office: 8606 Yellowhead Trail NW, Edmonton, AB T5B 1G1
Phone: 780-965-9595
Email: info@altagc.ca
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Alta-General-Contracting-1732578796958495/

Office hours are not published. Site visits can be requested on the quote form; Alta calls to confirm. Quality workmanship includes a 2 year warranty. Resumes go to info@altagc.ca.
